title.zh: 卷三十六 志第十六: 天文下
title.raw: 卷三十六 志第十六: 天文下 Volume 36 Treatises 16: Astronomy 2

meta.sourceNote: Body restored from Wikisource juan 36 to match the ChineseNotes chapter heading. The previous Wikisource import used the file number instead of the traditional juan.

sentences.zh: 天文之為十二次，所以辨析天體，紀綱辰象，上以考七曜之宿度，下以配萬方之分野，仰觀變謫，而驗之于郡國也。

translations.literal: Astronomy divides heaven into twelve celestial stations, thereby distinguishing celestial bodies and providing the framework for stellar phenomena—above, to verify the lodge-degrees of the seven luminaries; below, to match the territorial fields of the myriad regions; gazing upward at transformations and anomalies, and testing them against the commanderies and kingdoms.
translations.idiomatic: Astronomy divides heaven into twelve celestial stations to distinguish celestial bodies and organize stellar phenomena—above, to verify the lodge-degrees of the seven luminaries; below, to match the territorial fields of the myriad regions; gazing upward at transformations and anomalies and testing them against the commanderies and kingdoms.

sentences.zh: 《傳》曰：「歲在星紀，而淫于玄枵。」

translations.literal: The Commentary says: "The year stood in Xingji, yet strayed into Xuanxiao."
translations.idiomatic: The Commentary says: "The year stood in Xingji, yet strayed into Xuanxiao."

sentences.zh: 「姜氏、任氏，實守其地。」

translations.literal: "The Jiang and Ren clans in truth held those lands."
translations.idiomatic: "The Jiang and Ren clans in truth held those lands."

sentences.zh: 及七國交爭，善星者有甘德、石申，更配十二分野，故有周、秦、齊、楚、韓、趙、燕、魏、宋、衛、魯、鄭、吳、越等國。

translations.literal: When the Seven States contended, those skilled in stars included Gan De and Shi Shen, who reassigned the twelve territorial fields, hence there were the states of Zhou, Qin, Qi, Chu, Han, Zhao, Yan, Wei, Song, Wei, Lu, Zheng, Wu, Yue, and others.
translations.idiomatic: When the Seven States contended, those skilled in stars included Gan De and Shi Shen, who reassigned the twelve territorial fields, hence there were the states of Zhou, Qin, Qi, Chu, Han, Zhao, Yan, Wei, Song, Wei, Lu, Zheng, Wu, Yue, and others.

sentences.zh: 張衡、蔡邕，又以漢郡配焉。

translations.literal: Zhang Heng and Cai Yong further matched them to Han commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Heng and Cai Yong further matched them to Han commanderies.

sentences.zh: 自此因循，但守其舊文，無所變革。

translations.literal: From this point they followed precedent, merely preserving the old texts without any reform.
translations.idiomatic: From this point they followed precedent, merely preserving the old texts without any reform.

sentences.zh: 且懸象在上，終天不易，而郡國沿革，名稱屢遷，遂令後學難為憑准。

translations.literal: Moreover, the suspended signs above remain unchanged throughout heaven, while commanderies and kingdoms underwent successive changes and names were repeatedly altered, so that later students found it difficult to rely on them as standards.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the suspended signs above remain unchanged throughout heaven, while commanderies and kingdoms underwent successive changes and names were repeatedly altered, so that later students found it difficult to rely on them as standards.

sentences.zh: 貞觀中，李淳風撰《法象志》，始以唐之州縣配焉。

translations.literal: During the Zhenguan era, Li Chunfeng compiled the Record of Celestial Forms, first matching them to the prefectures and counties of Tang.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhenguan era, Li Chunfeng compiled the Record of Celestial Forms, first matching them to the prefectures and counties of Tang.

sentences.zh: 至開元初，沙門一行又增損其書，更為詳密。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Kaiyuan era, the monk Yixing further revised and supplemented his book, making it still more detailed.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Kaiyuan era, the monk Yixing further revised and supplemented his book, making it still more detailed.

sentences.zh: 既事包今古，與舊有異同，頗裨後學，故錄其文著於篇。

translations.literal: Since it embraced matters from antiquity to the present and differed in places from earlier accounts, it greatly aided later students; therefore its text is recorded here in full.
translations.idiomatic: Since it embraced matters from antiquity to the present and differed in places from earlier accounts, it greatly aided later students; therefore its text is recorded here in full.

sentences.zh: 並配武德以來交蝕淺深及注蝕不虧，以紀日月之變云爾。

translations.literal: It also records the depth of conjunctions and eclipses since the Wude era, and eclipses in which the disk was not fully obscured, to chronicle the transformations of sun and moon.
translations.idiomatic: It also records the depth of conjunctions and eclipses since the Wude era, and eclipses in which the disk was not fully obscured, to chronicle the transformations of sun and moon.

sentences.zh: 須女、虛、危，玄枵之次。

translations.literal: Nü, Xu, and Wei—the station of Xuanxiao.
translations.idiomatic: Nü, Xu, and Wei—the station of Xuanxiao.

sentences.zh: 子初起女五度，二千三百七十四分，秒四少。

translations.literal: At the beginning of zi it starts at Nü, five degrees, two thousand three hundred seventy-four minutes, four seconds slightly deficient.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of zi it starts at Nü, five degrees, two thousand three hundred seventy-four minutes, four seconds slightly deficient.

sentences.zh: 中虛九度，終危十二度。

translations.literal: The midpoint is at Xu, nine degrees; it ends at Wei, twelve degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The midpoint is at Xu, nine degrees; it ends at Wei, twelve degrees.

sentences.zh: 其分野：自濟北郡東逾濟水，涉平陰至於山茌，漢太山郡山茌縣，屬齊州西南之界。

translations.literal: Its territorial field: from Jibei Commandery eastward across the Ji River, crossing Pingyin to Shanzhi—Shanzhi County of Han Mount Tai Commandery, on the southwestern border of Qi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Its territorial field: from Jibei Commandery eastward across the Ji River, crossing Pingyin to Shanzhi—Shanzhi County of Han Mount Tai Commandery, on the southwestern border of Qi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 東南及高密，漢高密國，今在密州北界。

translations.literal: Southeastward to Gaomi—the Han Kingdom of Gaomi, now on the northern border of Mi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Southeastward to Gaomi—the Han Kingdom of Gaomi, now on the northern border of Mi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 自此以上，玄枵之分。

translations.literal: From here upward belongs to the field of Xuanxiao.
translations.idiomatic: From here upward belongs to the field of Xuanxiao.

sentences.zh: 東盡東萊之地，漢之東萊郡及膠東國，今為萊州、登州也。

translations.literal: Eastward to the lands of Donglai—Han's Donglai Commandery and the Kingdom of Jiaodong, now Laizhou and Dengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Eastward to the lands of Donglai—Han's Donglai Commandery and the Kingdom of Jiaodong, now Laizhou and Dengzhou.

sentences.zh: 又得漢之北海、千乘、淄川、濟南、齊郡，今為淄、青、齊等州，及濟州東界。

translations.literal: It also includes Han's Beihai, Qiancheng, Zichuan, Jinan, and Qi Commanderies, now Zi, Qing, and Qi prefectures, and the eastern border of Ji Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It also includes Han's Beihai, Qiancheng, Zichuan, Jinan, and Qi Commanderies, now Zi, Qing, and Qi prefectures, and the eastern border of Ji Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 及平原、渤海，盡九河故道之南，濱于碣石。

translations.literal: And Pingyuan and Bohai, to the south of the old course of the Nine Rivers, bordering Jieshi.
translations.idiomatic: And Pingyuan and Bohai, to the south of the old course of the Nine Rivers, bordering Jieshi.

sentences.zh: 今為德州、棣州，滄州其北界。

translations.literal: Now Dezhou and Di Prefecture; Cang Prefecture forms its northern border.
translations.idiomatic: Now Dezhou and Di Prefecture; Cang Prefecture forms its northern border.

sentences.zh: 自九河故道之北，屬析木分也。

translations.literal: North of the old course of the Nine Rivers belongs to the field of Ximu.
translations.idiomatic: North of the old course of the Nine Rivers belongs to the field of Ximu.

sentences.zh: 營室、東壁，陬訾之次。

translations.literal: Yingshi and Dongbi—the station of Zouzi.
translations.idiomatic: Yingshi and Dongbi—the station of Zouzi.

sentences.zh: 亥初起危十三度，二千九百二十六分太。

translations.literal: At the beginning of hai it starts at Wei, thirteen degrees, two thousand nine hundred twenty-six minutes slightly excess.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of hai it starts at Wei, thirteen degrees, two thousand nine hundred twenty-six minutes slightly excess.

sentences.zh: 中室十二度，五百五十分，秒二十一半。

translations.literal: The midpoint is at Shi, twelve degrees, five hundred fifty minutes, twenty-one and a half seconds.
translations.idiomatic: The midpoint is at Shi, twelve degrees, five hundred fifty minutes, twenty-one and a half seconds.

sentences.zh: 終奎一度。

translations.literal: It ends at Kui, one degree.
translations.idiomatic: It ends at Kui, one degree.

sentences.zh: 其分野：自王屋、太行而東，盡漢河內之地，今為懷州、洺、衛州之西境。

translations.literal: Its territorial field: from Wangwu and the Taihang eastward, encompassing all of Han's Henei lands, now the western borders of Huaizhou, Ming, and Wei prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Its territorial field: from Wangwu and the Taihang eastward, encompassing all of Han's Henei lands, now the western borders of Huaizhou, Ming, and Wei prefectures.

sentences.zh: 北負漳、鄴，東及館陶、聊城，漢地自黎陽、內黃及鄴、魏、武安，東至館陶、元城，皆屬魏郡；

translations.literal: Northward it bears upon Zhang and Ye, eastward to Guantao and Liaocheng—Han lands from Liyang, Neihuang, Ye, Wei, and Wu'an east to Guantao and Yuancheng all belonged to Wei Commandery;
translations.idiomatic: Northward it bears upon Zhang and Ye, eastward to Guantao and Liaocheng—Han lands from Liyang, Neihuang, Ye, Wei, and Wu'an east to Guantao and Yuancheng all belonged to Wei Commandery;

sentences.zh: 自頓邱、三城、武陽，東至聊城，皆屬東郡。

translations.literal: from Dunqiu, Sancheng, and Wuyang east to Liaocheng all belonged to Dong Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: from Dunqiu, Sancheng, and Wuyang east to Liaocheng all belonged to Dong Commandery.

sentences.zh: 今為相、魏、衛州。

translations.literal: Now Xiang, Wei, and Wei prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Now Xiang, Wei, and Wei prefectures.

sentences.zh: 東盡漢東郡之地，漢東郡、清河，西南至白馬、濮陽，東至東河、須昌，濱濟，至於鄆城。

translations.literal: Eastward to the lands of Han's Dong Commandery—Han's Dong and Qinghe commanderies, southwest to Baima and Puyang, east to Donghe and Xuchang, bordering the Ji, reaching Yuncheng.
translations.idiomatic: Eastward to the lands of Han's Dong Commandery—Han's Dong and Qinghe commanderies, southwest to Baima and Puyang, east to Donghe and Xuchang, bordering the Ji, reaching Yuncheng.

sentences.zh: 今為滑州、濮州、鄆州。

translations.literal: Now Hua, Pu, and Yun prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Now Hua, Pu, and Yun prefectures.

sentences.zh: 其須昌、濟東之地，屬降婁，非豕韋也。

translations.literal: The lands of Xuchang and Jidong belong to Jianglü, not to Zhuwei.
translations.idiomatic: The lands of Xuchang and Jidong belong to Jianglü, not to Zhuwei.

sentences.zh: 奎、婁及胃，降婁之次。

translations.literal: Kui, Lou, and Wei—the station of Jianglü.
translations.idiomatic: Kui, Lou, and Wei—the station of Jianglü.

sentences.zh: 戌初起奎二度，一千二百一十七分，秒十七少。

translations.literal: At the beginning of xu it starts at Kui, two degrees, one thousand two hundred seventeen minutes, seventeen seconds slightly deficient.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of xu it starts at Kui, two degrees, one thousand two hundred seventeen minutes, seventeen seconds slightly deficient.

sentences.zh: 中婁一度，一千八百八十三。

translations.literal: The midpoint is at Lou, one degree, one thousand eight hundred eighty-three.
translations.idiomatic: The midpoint is at Lou, one degree, one thousand eight hundred eighty-three.

sentences.zh: 終胃三度。

translations.literal: It ends at Wei, three degrees.
translations.idiomatic: It ends at Wei, three degrees.

sentences.zh: 其分野：南屆钜野，東達梁父，以負東海。

translations.literal: Its territorial field: southward to Juye, eastward to Liangfu, bearing upon the Eastern Sea.
translations.idiomatic: Its territorial field: southward to Juye, eastward to Liangfu, bearing upon the Eastern Sea.

sentences.zh: 又東至於呂梁，乃東南抵淮水，而東盡于徐夷之地。

translations.literal: Also eastward to Lüliang, then southeast to the Huai River, and eastward to the lands of the Xu Yi.
translations.idiomatic: Also eastward to Lüliang, then southeast to the Huai River, and eastward to the lands of the Xu Yi.

sentences.zh: 東為降婁之次。

translations.literal: Eastward is the station of Jianglü.
translations.idiomatic: Eastward is the station of Jianglü.

sentences.zh: 得漢東平、魯國。

translations.literal: It includes Han's Dongping and Lu.
translations.idiomatic: It includes Han's Dongping and Lu.

sentences.zh: 漢東平國在任城、平陸，今在兗州。

translations.literal: Han's Dongping was at Rencheng and Pinglu, now in Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Han's Dongping was at Rencheng and Pinglu, now in Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 奎為大澤，在陬訾之下流，濱於淮、泗，東北負山，為婁、胃之墟。

translations.literal: Kui is the Great Marsh, below the downstream of Zouzi, bordering the Huai and Si, bearing mountains to the northeast—the domain of Lou and Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Kui is the Great Marsh, below the downstream of Zouzi, bordering the Huai and Si, bearing mountains to the northeast—the domain of Lou and Wei.

sentences.zh: 蓋中國膏腴之地，百穀之所阜也。

translations.literal: It is in general the fertile heartland of China, where the hundred grains flourish.
translations.idiomatic: It is in general the fertile heartland of China, where the hundred grains flourish.

sentences.zh: 胃星得馬牧之氣，與冀之北土同占。

translations.literal: The Wei star receives the qi of horse pasture, sharing the same astrological correspondence as the northern lands of Ji.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei star receives the qi of horse pasture, sharing the same astrological correspondence as the northern lands of Ji.

sentences.zh: 昴、畢，大梁之次。

translations.literal: Mao and Bi—the station of Daliang.
translations.idiomatic: Mao and Bi—the station of Daliang.

sentences.zh: 畢酉初起胃四度，二千五百四十九分，秒八太。

translations.literal: At the beginning of you it starts at Wei, four degrees, two thousand five hundred forty-nine minutes, eight seconds slightly excess.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of you it starts at Wei, four degrees, two thousand five hundred forty-nine minutes, eight seconds slightly excess.

sentences.zh: 中昴六度，一百七十四分半。

translations.literal: The midpoint is at Mao, six degrees, one hundred seventy-four and a half minutes.
translations.idiomatic: The midpoint is at Mao, six degrees, one hundred seventy-four and a half minutes.

sentences.zh: 終畢九度。

translations.literal: It ends at Bi, nine degrees.
translations.idiomatic: It ends at Bi, nine degrees.

sentences.zh: 其分野：自魏郡濁漳之北，得漢之趙國、廣平、钜鹿、常山，東及清河、信都，北據中山、真定。

translations.literal: Its territorial field: from the north of the muddy Zhang in Wei Commandery, it includes Han's Zhao, Guangping, Julu, and Changshan, east to Qinghe and Xindu, northward occupying Zhongshan and Zhending.
translations.idiomatic: Its territorial field: from the north of the muddy Zhang in Wei Commandery, it includes Han's Zhao, Guangping, Julu, and Changshan, east to Qinghe and Xindu, northward occupying Zhongshan and Zhending.

sentences.zh: 今為洺、趙、邢、恆、定、冀、貝、深八州。

translations.literal: Now Ming, Zhao, Xing, Heng, Ding, Ji, Bei, and Shen—the eight prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Now Ming, Zhao, Xing, Heng, Ding, Ji, Bei, and Shen—the eight prefectures.

sentences.zh: 又分相、魏、博之北界，與瀛州之西，全趙之分。

translations.literal: Also dividing the northern borders of Xiang, Wei, and Bo and the west of Ying Prefecture—all belong to the field of Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: Also dividing the northern borders of Xiang, Wei, and Bo and the west of Ying Prefecture—all belong to the field of Zhao.

sentences.zh: 又北盡漢代郡、雁門、雲中、定襄之地，與北方群狄之國，皆大梁分也。

translations.literal: Also northward to the limits of Han's Dai, Yanmen, Yunzhong, and Dingxiang, and the northern states of the various Di—all belong to the field of Daliang.
translations.idiomatic: Also northward to the limits of Han's Dai, Yanmen, Yunzhong, and Dingxiang, and the northern states of the various Di—all belong to the field of Daliang.

sentences.zh: 觜觿、參伐，實沈之次也。

translations.literal: Zixī and Canfa—the station of Sishen.
translations.idiomatic: Zixī and Canfa—the station of Sishen.

sentences.zh: 申初起畢十度，八百四十一分，十五太。

translations.literal: At the beginning of shen it starts at Bi, ten degrees, eight hundred forty-one minutes, fifteen seconds slightly excess.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of shen it starts at Bi, ten degrees, eight hundred forty-one minutes, fifteen seconds slightly excess.

sentences.zh: 中參七度，一千五百二十六，終井十一度。

translations.literal: The midpoint is at Shen, seven degrees, one thousand five hundred twenty-six; it ends at Jing, eleven degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The midpoint is at Shen, seven degrees, one thousand five hundred twenty-six; it ends at Jing, eleven degrees.

sentences.zh: 其分野：得漢河東郡，今為蒲、絳、晉州，又得澤州及慈州界也。

translations.literal: Its territorial field: it includes Han's Hedong Commandery, now Pu, Jiang, and Jin prefectures, and also the borders of Ze and Ci prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Its territorial field: it includes Han's Hedong Commandery, now Pu, Jiang, and Jin prefectures, and also the borders of Ze and Ci prefectures.

sentences.zh: 及上黨、今為澤、潞、儀、沁也。

translations.literal: And Shangdang—now Ze, Lu, Yi, and Qin prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: And Shangdang—now Ze, Lu, Yi, and Qin prefectures.

sentences.zh: 太原，今為並、汾州。

translations.literal: Taiyuan—now Bing and Fen prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Taiyuan—now Bing and Fen prefectures.

sentences.zh: 盡西河之地。

translations.literal: To the limits of Xihe lands.
translations.idiomatic: To the limits of Xihe lands.

sentences.zh: 今為隰州、石州、嵐州，西涉河，得銀州以北也。

translations.literal: Now Xi, Shi, and Lan prefectures; westward across the river, reaching north of Yin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Now Xi, Shi, and Lan prefectures; westward across the river, reaching north of Yin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 又西河戎狄之國，皆實沈分也。

translations.literal: Also the Rong and Di states of Xihe—all belong to the field of Sishen.
translations.idiomatic: Also the Rong and Di states of Xihe—all belong to the field of Sishen.

sentences.zh: 今河東郡永樂、芮城、河北縣及河曲豐、勝、夏州，皆為實沈之次，東井之分也。

translations.literal: Now Hedong Commandery's Yongle, Ruicheng, Hebei County, and the Hequ region of Feng, Sheng, and Xia prefectures all belong to the station of Sishen and the field of Dongjing.
translations.idiomatic: Now Hedong Commandery's Yongle, Ruicheng, Hebei County, and the Hequ region of Feng, Sheng, and Xia prefectures all belong to the station of Sishen and the field of Dongjing.

sentences.zh: 參伐為戎索，為武政，故殷河東，盡大夏之墟。

translations.literal: Canfa is the Rong cord, the domain of martial governance; therefore the Yin held Hedong and encompassed the ruins of Great Xia.
translations.idiomatic: Canfa is the Rong cord, the domain of martial governance; therefore the Yin held Hedong and encompassed the ruins of Great Xia.

sentences.zh: 上党次居下流，與趙、魏相接，為觜觿之分。

translations.literal: Shangdang lies in the lower reaches, adjoining Zhao and Wei—the field of Zixī.
translations.idiomatic: Shangdang lies in the lower reaches, adjoining Zhao and Wei—the field of Zixī.

sentences.zh: 東井、輿鬼，鶉首之次也。

translations.literal: Dongjing and Yuji—the station of Zhenshou.
translations.idiomatic: Dongjing and Yuji—the station of Zhenshou.

sentences.zh: 未初起井十二度，二千一百七十二秒，十五太。

translations.literal: At the beginning of wei it starts at Jing, twelve degrees, two thousand one hundred seventy-two seconds, fifteen seconds slightly excess.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of wei it starts at Jing, twelve degrees, two thousand one hundred seventy-two seconds, fifteen seconds slightly excess.

sentences.zh: 中井二十七度，二千八百二十八分，秒一半。

translations.literal: The midpoint is at Jing, twenty-seven degrees, two thousand eight hundred twenty-eight minutes, one and a half seconds.
translations.idiomatic: The midpoint is at Jing, twenty-seven degrees, two thousand eight hundred twenty-eight minutes, one and a half seconds.

sentences.zh: 終柳六度。

translations.literal: It ends at Liu, six degrees.
translations.idiomatic: It ends at Liu, six degrees.

sentences.zh: 其分野：自漢之三輔及北地、上郡、安定，西自隴坻至河西，西南盡巴、蜀、漢中之地，及西南夷犍為、越巂、益州郡，極南河之表，東至牂柯，皆鶉首分也。

translations.literal: Its territorial field: from Han's Three Metropolises and Beidi, Shang, and Anding, west from Longqi to Hexi, southwest to the lands of Ba, Shu, and Hanzhong, and the southwestern Yi of Jianwei, Yuexi, and Yizhou commanderies, to the southern limit beyond the Yellow River, east to Zangke—all belong to the field of Zhenshou.
translations.idiomatic: Its territorial field: from Han's Three Metropolises and Beidi, Shang, and Anding, west from Longqi to Hexi, southwest to the lands of Ba, Shu, and Hanzhong, and the southwestern Yi of Jianwei, Yuexi, and Yizhou commanderies, to the southern limit beyond the Yellow River, east to Zangke—all belong to the field of Zhenshou.

sentences.zh: 鶉首之分，得《禹貢》雍、梁二州，其郡縣易知，故不詳載。

translations.literal: The field of Zhenshou includes Yong and Liang of the Documents of Yu; its commanderies and counties are easy to identify, and therefore are not recorded in detail.
translations.idiomatic: The field of Zhenshou includes Yong and Liang of the Documents of Yu; its commanderies and counties are easy to identify, and therefore are not recorded in detail.

sentences.zh: 狼星分野在江、河上源之西，孤矢、犬、雞，皆徼外之象。

translations.literal: The territorial field of the Wolf star lies west of the upper reaches of the Yangtze and Han rivers; the Lonely Arrow, Dog, and Rooster—all are signs beyond the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: The territorial field of the Wolf star lies west of the upper reaches of the Yangtze and Han rivers; the Lonely Arrow, Dog, and Rooster—all are signs beyond the frontier.

sentences.zh: 今之西羌、吐蕃、蕃渾，及西南徼外夷，皆狼星之象。

translations.literal: Today's Western Qiang, Tibet, and the Fan and Hun, and the southwestern frontier Yi beyond the passes—all are signs of the Wolf star.
translations.idiomatic: Today's Western Qiang, Tibet, and the Fan and Hun, and the southwestern frontier Yi beyond the passes—all are signs of the Wolf star.

sentences.zh: 柳、星、張，鶉火之次。

translations.literal: Liu, Xing, and Zhang—the station of Zhenhuo.
translations.idiomatic: Liu, Xing, and Zhang—the station of Zhenhuo.

sentences.zh: 午初起柳七度，四百六十四，秒七少。

translations.literal: At the beginning of wu it starts at Liu, seven degrees, four hundred sixty-four, seven seconds slightly deficient.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of wu it starts at Liu, seven degrees, four hundred sixty-four, seven seconds slightly deficient.

sentences.zh: 中七星七度，一千一百三。

translations.literal: The midpoint is at the Seven Stars, seven degrees, one thousand one hundred three.
translations.idiomatic: The midpoint is at the Seven Stars, seven degrees, one thousand one hundred three.

sentences.zh: 終張十四度。

translations.literal: It ends at Zhang, fourteen degrees.
translations.idiomatic: It ends at Zhang, fourteen degrees.

sentences.zh: 其分野：北自滎澤、滎陽，並京、索，暨山南，得新鄭、密縣，至於方陽。

translations.literal: Its territorial field: north from Xingze and Xingyang, including Jing and Suo, and the southern mountains, reaching Xinzheng and Mi County to Fangyang.
translations.idiomatic: Its territorial field: north from Xingze and Xingyang, including Jing and Suo, and the southern mountains, reaching Xinzheng and Mi County to Fangyang.

sentences.zh: 方陽之南得漢之潁川郡陽翟、崇高、郟城、襄城，南盡鄴縣。

translations.literal: South of Fangyang it includes Han's Yingchuan Commandery—Yangzhai, Chonggao, Jiacheng, and Xiangcheng, south to Ye County.
translations.idiomatic: South of Fangyang it includes Han's Yingchuan Commandery—Yangzhai, Chonggao, Jiacheng, and Xiangcheng, south to Ye County.

sentences.zh: 今為鄧、汝、唐、仙四州界。

translations.literal: Now the borders of Deng, Ru, Tang, and Xian—the four prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Now the borders of Deng, Ru, Tang, and Xian—the four prefectures.

sentences.zh: 又漢南陽郡，北自宛、葉，南盡漢東申、隨之地，大抵以淮源桐柏、東陽為限。

translations.literal: Also Han's Nanyang Commandery, north from Wan and Ye, south to Shen and Sui of eastern Han—generally bounded by the Tongbai source of the Huai, and Dongyang.
translations.idiomatic: Also Han's Nanyang Commandery, north from Wan and Ye, south to Shen and Sui of eastern Han—generally bounded by the Tongbai source of the Huai, and Dongyang.

sentences.zh: 今之唐州、隨州屬鶉火，申州屬壽星。

translations.literal: Now Tang and Sui prefectures belong to Zhenhuo; Shen Prefecture belongs to Shouxing.
translations.idiomatic: Now Tang and Sui prefectures belong to Zhenhuo; Shen Prefecture belongs to Shouxing.

sentences.zh: 又自洛邑負河之南，西及函谷南紀，達武當漢水之陰，盡弘農郡。

translations.literal: Also from Luoyi south of the Yellow River, west to the southern limit at Hangu Pass, reaching the northern bank of the Wudang Han River, to the limits of Hongnong Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Also from Luoyi south of the Yellow River, west to the southern limit at Hangu Pass, reaching the northern bank of the Wudang Han River, to the limits of Hongnong Commandery.

sentences.zh: 漢弘農盧氏、陝縣，今為虢、陝二州。

translations.literal: Han's Hongnong—Lushi and Shan County, now Guo and Shan—the two prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Han's Hongnong—Lushi and Shan County, now Guo and Shan—the two prefectures.

sentences.zh: 上洛、商洛為商州。

translations.literal: Shangluo and Shangluo are Shang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Shangluo and Shangluo are Shang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丹水為均州。

translations.literal: The Danshui is Jun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Danshui is Jun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 宜陽、沔池、新安、陸渾，今屬洛州。

translations.literal: Yiyang, Mianchi, Xin'an, and Luhun—now belonging to Luo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yiyang, Mianchi, Xin'an, and Luhun—now belonging to Luo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 古成周、虢、鄭、管、鄶、東虢、密、滑、焦、唐、申、鄧，皆鶉火分也，及祝融氏之都。

translations.literal: Ancient Chengzhou, Guo, Zheng, Guan, Kuai, Eastern Guo, Mi, Hua, Jiao, Tang, Shen, and Deng—all belong to the field of Zhenhuo, and to the capital of Zhurong.
translations.idiomatic: Ancient Chengzhou, Guo, Zheng, Guan, Kuai, Eastern Guo, Mi, Hua, Jiao, Tang, Shen, and Deng—all belong to the field of Zhenhuo, and to the capital of Zhurong.

sentences.zh: 新鄭為祝融氏之墟，屬鶉火。

translations.literal: Xinzheng is the domain of Zhurong, belonging to Zhenhuo.
translations.idiomatic: Xinzheng is the domain of Zhurong, belonging to Zhenhuo.

sentences.zh: 其東鄙則入壽星。

translations.literal: Its eastern border enters Shouxing.
translations.idiomatic: Its eastern border enters Shouxing.

sentences.zh: 舊說皆在函谷，非也。

translations.literal: Older accounts place them all at Hangu Pass—this is incorrect.
translations.idiomatic: Older accounts place them all at Hangu Pass—this is incorrect.

sentences.zh: 柳、星、輿鬼之東，又接漢源，故殷商、洛之陽，接南河之上流。

translations.literal: East of Liu, Xing, and Yuji again adjoins the Han source; therefore the Yin held Shang and the south of Luo, adjoining the upper reaches of the southern Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: East of Liu, Xing, and Yuji again adjoins the Han source; therefore the Yin held Shang and the south of Luo, adjoining the upper reaches of the southern Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 七星上系軒轅，得土行之正位，中嶽象也，故為河南之分。

translations.literal: The Seven Stars are tied to Xuanyuan, receiving the orthodox position of the Earth element—the image of the Central Peak; therefore they are the field of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: The Seven Stars are tied to Xuanyuan, receiving the orthodox position of the Earth element—the image of the Central Peak; therefore they are the field of Henan.

sentences.zh: 張星直河南漢東，與鶉尾同占。

translations.literal: The Zhang star stands directly south of Henan and east of Han, sharing the same astrological correspondence as Zhenwei.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhang star stands directly south of Henan and east of Han, sharing the same astrological correspondence as Zhenwei.

sentences.zh: 翼、軫，鶉尾之次。

translations.literal: Yi and Zhen—the station of Zhenwei.
translations.idiomatic: Yi and Zhen—the station of Zhenwei.

sentences.zh: 巳初起張十五度，一千七百九十五，秒二十二少。

translations.literal: At the beginning of si it starts at Zhang, fifteen degrees, one thousand seven hundred ninety-five, twenty-two seconds slightly deficient.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of si it starts at Zhang, fifteen degrees, one thousand seven hundred ninety-five, twenty-two seconds slightly deficient.

sentences.zh: 中翼十二度，二千四百六十一，秒八半。

translations.literal: The midpoint is at Yi, twelve degrees, two thousand four hundred sixty-one, eight and a half seconds.
translations.idiomatic: The midpoint is at Yi, twelve degrees, two thousand four hundred sixty-one, eight and a half seconds.

sentences.zh: 終軫九度。

translations.literal: It ends at Zhen, nine degrees.
translations.idiomatic: It ends at Zhen, nine degrees.

sentences.zh: 其分野：自房陵、白帝而東，盡漢之南郡、南郡：巫縣，今在夔州。

translations.literal: Its territorial field: from Fangling and Baidi eastward, to the limits of Han's Nan, Nan Commandery—Wu County, now in Kui Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Its territorial field: from Fangling and Baidi eastward, to the limits of Han's Nan, Nan Commandery—Wu County, now in Kui Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 秭歸在西，夷陵在峽州。

translations.literal: Zigui is to the west; Yiling is in Xia Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zigui is to the west; Yiling is in Xia Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 襄、夔、郢、申在襄、郢界，餘為荊州。

translations.literal: Xiang, Kui, Ying, and Shen lie on the Xiang and Ying border; the remainder is Jing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang, Kui, Ying, and Shen lie on the Xiang and Ying border; the remainder is Jing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 江夏，江夏：竟陵今為復州，安、鄂、蘄、沔、黃五州，皆漢江夏界。

translations.literal: Jiangxia—Jiangxia: Jingling is now Fu Prefecture; An, E, Qi, Mian, and Huang—the five prefectures—are all within Han's Jiangxia border.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxia—Jiangxia: Jingling is now Fu Prefecture; An, E, Qi, Mian, and Huang—the five prefectures—are all within Han's Jiangxia border.

sentences.zh: 東達廬江南郡。

translations.literal: Eastward to Lujiang and Nan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Eastward to Lujiang and Nan Commandery.

sentences.zh: 漢廬江之尋陽，今在江州，于山河之像，宜屬鶉尾也。

translations.literal: Han's Xunyang of Lujiang is now in Jiang Prefecture; in the image of mountains and rivers it ought to belong to Zhenwei.
translations.idiomatic: Han's Xunyang of Lujiang is now in Jiang Prefecture; in the image of mountains and rivers it ought to belong to Zhenwei.

sentences.zh: 濱彭蠡之西，得漢長沙、武陵、桂陽、零陵郡。

translations.literal: Bordering the west of Poyang, it includes Han's Changsha, Wuling, Guiyang, and Lingling commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: Bordering the west of Poyang, it includes Han's Changsha, Wuling, Guiyang, and Lingling commanderies.

sentences.zh: 零陵今為道州、永州。

translations.literal: Lingling is now Dao and Yong prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Lingling is now Dao and Yong prefectures.

sentences.zh: 桂陽今為郴州。

translations.literal: Guiyang is now Chen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Guiyang is now Chen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 大抵自沅、湘上流，西通黔安之左，皆楚之分也。

translations.literal: Generally from the upper reaches of the Yuan and Xiang, west connecting to the left of Qian'an—all belong to the field of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: Generally from the upper reaches of the Yuan and Xiang, west connecting to the left of Qian'an—all belong to the field of Chu.

sentences.zh: 又逾南紀，盡郁林、合浦之地。

translations.literal: Also crossing the southern limit, to the lands of Yulin and Hepu.
translations.idiomatic: Also crossing the southern limit, to the lands of Yulin and Hepu.

sentences.zh: 郁林縣今在貴州。

translations.literal: Yulin County is now in Gui Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yulin County is now in Gui Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 定林縣今在廉州。

translations.literal: Dinglin County is now in Lian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Dinglin County is now in Lian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 合浦縣今為桂州。

translations.literal: Hepu County is now Gui Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Hepu County is now Gui Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 今自富、昭、蒙、龔、繡、容、白、罕八州以西，皆屬鶉尾之墟也。

translations.literal: Now from Fu, Zhao, Meng, Gong, Xiu, Rong, Bai, and Han—the eight prefectures westward—all belong to the domain of Zhenwei.
translations.idiomatic: Now from Fu, Zhao, Meng, Gong, Xiu, Rong, Bai, and Han—the eight prefectures westward—all belong to the domain of Zhenwei.

sentences.zh: 荊、楚、鄖、鄀、羅、權、巴、夔與南方蠻貊，殷河南之南。

translations.literal: Jing, Chu, Yun, E, Luo, Quan, Ba, and Kui, and the southern Man and Mo—the Yin south of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Jing, Chu, Yun, E, Luo, Quan, Ba, and Kui, and the southern Man and Mo—the Yin south of Henan.

sentences.zh: 其中一星主長沙國，逾嶺徼而南，皆甌東、青丘之分。

translations.literal: Among them one star governs the Kingdom of Changsha; crossing the ranges southward—all belong to the fields of Ou East and Green Hill.
translations.idiomatic: Among them one star governs the Kingdom of Changsha; crossing the ranges southward—all belong to the fields of Ou East and Green Hill.

sentences.zh: 今安南諸州，在雲漢上源之東，宜屬鶉火。

translations.literal: Now the various prefectures of Annan, east of the upper source of the Cloudy Han, ought to belong to Zhenhuo.
translations.idiomatic: Now the various prefectures of Annan, east of the upper source of the Cloudy Han, ought to belong to Zhenhuo.

sentences.zh: 角、亢，壽星之次。

translations.literal: Jiao and Kang—the station of Shouxing.
translations.idiomatic: Jiao and Kang—the station of Shouxing.

sentences.zh: 辰初起軫十度，八十七，秒十四半。

translations.literal: At the beginning of chen it starts at Zhen, ten degrees, eighty-seven, fourteen and a half seconds.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of chen it starts at Zhen, ten degrees, eighty-seven, fourteen and a half seconds.

sentences.zh: 中角八度，七百五十，秒三十。

translations.literal: The midpoint is at Jiao, eight degrees, seven hundred fifty, thirty seconds.
translations.idiomatic: The midpoint is at Jiao, eight degrees, seven hundred fifty, thirty seconds.

sentences.zh: 終氐一度。

translations.literal: It ends at Di, one degree.
translations.idiomatic: It ends at Di, one degree.

sentences.zh: 其分野：自原武、管城，濱河、濟之南，東至封邱、陳留，盡陳、蔡、汝南之地，逾淮源至於弋陽。

translations.literal: Its territorial field: from Yuanwu and Guancheng, south of the Yellow and Ji rivers, east to Fengqiu and Chenliu, to the lands of Chen, Cai, and Runan, crossing the Huai source to Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: Its territorial field: from Yuanwu and Guancheng, south of the Yellow and Ji rivers, east to Fengqiu and Chenliu, to the lands of Chen, Cai, and Runan, crossing the Huai source to Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 漢陳留郡，自封邱、陳留已東，皆入大火之分。

translations.literal: Han's Chenliu Commandery—from Fengqiu and Chenliu eastward—all enter the field of Great Fire.
translations.idiomatic: Han's Chenliu Commandery—from Fengqiu and Chenliu eastward—all enter the field of Great Fire.

sentences.zh: 漢汝南，今為豫州。

translations.literal: Han's Runan is now Yu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Han's Runan is now Yu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 西華、南頓、項城縣今為陳州。

translations.literal: Xihua, Nandun, and Xiangcheng counties are now Chen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Xihua, Nandun, and Xiangcheng counties are now Chen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 汝陰縣今在潁州。

translations.literal: Ruyin County is now in Ying Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Ruyin County is now in Ying Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 弋陽縣在光州。

translations.literal: Yiyang County is in Guang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yiyang County is in Guang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 西涉南陽郡，至於桐柏，又東北抵嵩之東陽。

translations.literal: Westward crossing Nanyang Commandery to Tongbai, and northeast reaching the Dongyang of Song.
translations.idiomatic: Westward crossing Nanyang Commandery to Tongbai, and northeast reaching the Dongyang of Song.

sentences.zh: 漢南陽郡舂陵、湖陽，蔡陽後分為舂陵郡，後魏以為南荊州，今有舊義陽郡，在申國之東界，今為申州。

translations.literal: Han's Nanyang Commandery—Chunling and Huyang; Yangcai was later divided into Chunling Commandery; Later Wei made it Southern Jing Prefecture; now there is the old Yiyang Commandery on the eastern border of Shen—now Shen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Han's Nanyang Commandery—Chunling and Huyang; Yangcai was later divided into Chunling Commandery; Later Wei made it Southern Jing Prefecture; now there is the old Yiyang Commandery on the eastern border of Shen—now Shen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 按中國地絡，在南北河之間，故申、隨、光三州，皆屬《禹貢》豫州之分，宜屬鶉火、壽星。

translations.literal: According to the terrestrial network of China, between the northern and southern Yellow Rivers, therefore Shen, Sui, and Guang—the three prefectures—all belong to the field of Yu in the Documents of Yu, and ought to belong to Zhenhuo and Shouxing.
translations.idiomatic: According to the terrestrial network of China, between the northern and southern Yellow Rivers, therefore Shen, Sui, and Guang—the three prefectures—all belong to the field of Yu in the Documents of Yu, and ought to belong to Zhenhuo and Shouxing.

sentences.zh: 非南方負海之地。

translations.literal: They are not lands of the south bearing upon the sea.
translations.idiomatic: They are not lands of the south bearing upon the sea.

sentences.zh: 古陳、蔡、隨、許，皆屬壽星分也。

translations.literal: Ancient Chen, Cai, Sui, and Xu—all belong to the field of Shouxing.
translations.idiomatic: Ancient Chen, Cai, Sui, and Xu—all belong to the field of Shouxing.

sentences.zh: 氐星涉壽星之次，故其分野殷雒邑眾山之東，與亳土相接。

translations.literal: The Di star crosses the station of Shouxing; therefore its territorial field is east of the many mountains of Luoyi, adjoining the lands of Bo.
translations.idiomatic: The Di star crosses the station of Shouxing; therefore its territorial field is east of the many mountains of Luoyi, adjoining the lands of Bo.

sentences.zh: 氐、房、心，大火之次也。

translations.literal: Di, Fang, and Xin—the station of Great Fire.
translations.idiomatic: Di, Fang, and Xin—the station of Great Fire.

sentences.zh: 卯初起氐二度，一千四百一十九分，秒五太。

translations.literal: At the beginning of mao it starts at Di, two degrees, one thousand four hundred nineteen minutes, five seconds slightly excess.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of mao it starts at Di, two degrees, one thousand four hundred nineteen minutes, five seconds slightly excess.

sentences.zh: 中房二度，二千八百五分，秒一半。

translations.literal: The midpoint is at Fang, two degrees, two thousand eight hundred five minutes, one and a half seconds.
translations.idiomatic: The midpoint is at Fang, two degrees, two thousand eight hundred five minutes, one and a half seconds.

sentences.zh: 終尾六度。

translations.literal: It ends at Wei, six degrees.
translations.idiomatic: It ends at Wei, six degrees.

sentences.zh: 其分野：得漢之陳留縣，自雍丘、襄邑、小黃而東，循濟陰，界于齊、魯，右泗水，達于呂梁，乃東南抵淮，西南接太昊之墟，盡濟陰、山陽、楚國、豐、沛之地。

translations.literal: Its territorial field: it includes Han's Chenliu County—from Yongqiu, Xiangyi, and Xiaohuang eastward, following Jiyin, bordering Qi and Lu, to the right of the Si River, reaching Lüliang, then southeast to the Huai, southwest connecting to the domain of Great Taihao, encompassing Jiyin, Shanyang, Chu, Feng, and Pei.
translations.idiomatic: Its territorial field: it includes Han's Chenliu County—from Yongqiu, Xiangyi, and Xiaohuang eastward, following Jiyin, bordering Qi and Lu, to the right of the Si River, reaching Lüliang, then southeast to the Huai, southwest connecting to the domain of Great Taihao, encompassing Jiyin, Shanyang, Chu, Feng, and Pei.

sentences.zh: 濟陰郡之定陶、冤句、乘氏，今在東郡。

translations.literal: Jiyin Commandery's Dingtao, Yuanqu, and Chengshi are now in Dong Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Jiyin Commandery's Dingtao, Yuanqu, and Chengshi are now in Dong Commandery.

sentences.zh: 大抵曹、宋、徐、亳及鄆州西界，皆屬大火分。

translations.literal: Generally Cao, Song, Xu, Bo, and the western border of Yun Prefecture—all belong to the field of Great Fire.
translations.idiomatic: Generally Cao, Song, Xu, Bo, and the western border of Yun Prefecture—all belong to the field of Great Fire.

sentences.zh: 自商、亳以負北河，陽氣之所升也，為心分。

translations.literal: From Shang and Bo north of the northern Yellow River—where yang qi ascends—is the field of Xin.
translations.idiomatic: From Shang and Bo north of the northern Yellow River—where yang qi ascends—is the field of Xin.

sentences.zh: 自豐、沛以負南河，陽氣之所布也，為房分。

translations.literal: From Feng and Pei south of the southern Yellow River—where yang qi spreads—is the field of Fang.
translations.idiomatic: From Feng and Pei south of the southern Yellow River—where yang qi spreads—is the field of Fang.

sentences.zh: 故其下流皆與尾星同占，西接陳、鄭，為氐星之分。

translations.literal: Therefore its lower reaches all share the same astrological correspondence as the Wei star, west connecting to Chen and Zheng—the field of the Di star.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore its lower reaches all share the same astrological correspondence as the Wei star, west connecting to Chen and Zheng—the field of the Di star.

sentences.zh: 尾、箕，析木之次也。

translations.literal: Wei and Ji—the station of Ximu.
translations.idiomatic: Wei and Ji—the station of Ximu.

sentences.zh: 寅初起尾七度，二千七百五十分，秒二十一少。

translations.literal: At the beginning of yin it starts at Wei, seven degrees, two thousand seven hundred fifty minutes, twenty-one seconds slightly deficient.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of yin it starts at Wei, seven degrees, two thousand seven hundred fifty minutes, twenty-one seconds slightly deficient.

sentences.zh: 中箕星五度，三百七十分，秒六十七。

translations.literal: The midpoint is at the Ji star, five degrees, three hundred seventy minutes, sixty-seven seconds.
translations.idiomatic: The midpoint is at the Ji star, five degrees, three hundred seventy minutes, sixty-seven seconds.

sentences.zh: 終斗八度。

translations.literal: It ends at Dou, eight degrees.
translations.idiomatic: It ends at Dou, eight degrees.

sentences.zh: 其分野：自渤海九河之北，盡河間、涿郡、廣陽國，漢渤海郡浮陽，今為清池縣，屬滄州。

translations.literal: Its territorial field: from north of the Nine Rivers of Bohai, to the limits of Hejian, Zhuo, and Guangyang—Han's Fuyang of Bohai Commandery is now Qingchi County, belonging to Cang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Its territorial field: from north of the Nine Rivers of Bohai, to the limits of Hejian, Zhuo, and Guangyang—Han's Fuyang of Bohai Commandery is now Qingchi County, belonging to Cang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 涿郡之饒陽，今屬瀛州。

translations.literal: Raoyang of Zhuo Commandery now belongs to Ying Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Raoyang of Zhuo Commandery now belongs to Ying Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 涿縣、良鄉與廣陽國薊縣，今在幽州。

translations.literal: Zhuo and Liangxiang counties and Ji County of Guangyang—all now in You Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuo and Liangxiang counties and Ji County of Guangyang—all now in You Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 及上谷、漁陽、右北平、遼東、樂浪、玄菟，漁陽在幽州。

translations.literal: And Shanggu, Yuyang, Youbeiping, Liaodong, Lelang, and Xuantu—Yuyang is in You Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: And Shanggu, Yuyang, Youbeiping, Liaodong, Lelang, and Xuantu—Yuyang is in You Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 右北平在白狼無終縣，隋代為漁陽郡，古孤竹國，後置北平郡，今為平州。

translations.literal: Youbeiping is at Wuzhong of Bailang; in the Sui era it became Yuyang Commandery, the ancient state of Gushu; later Beiping Commandery was established—now Ping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Youbeiping is at Wuzhong of Bailang; in the Sui era it became Yuyang Commandery, the ancient state of Gushu; later Beiping Commandery was established—now Ping Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 遼東在無慮縣，即《周禮》醫無閭山。

translations.literal: Liaodong is at Wulü County—the Yiwulü Mountain of the Rites of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Liaodong is at Wulü County—the Yiwulü Mountain of the Rites of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 樂浪在朝鮮縣，玄菟在高句驪縣，今皆在東夷也。

translations.literal: Lelang is at Chaoxian County; Xuantu is at Gaogouli County—all now in the Eastern Yi.
translations.idiomatic: Lelang is at Chaoxian County; Xuantu is at Gaogouli County—all now in the Eastern Yi.

sentences.zh: 古之北燕、孤竹、無終及東方九夷之國，皆析木之分也，尾得雲漢之末流，北紀之所窮也。

translations.literal: The ancient Northern Yan, Gushu, Wuzhong, and the states of the Nine Yi of the east—all belong to the field of Ximu; Wei receives the lower stream of the Cloudy Han, where the northern limit ends.
translations.idiomatic: The ancient Northern Yan, Gushu, Wuzhong, and the states of the Nine Yi of the east—all belong to the field of Ximu; Wei receives the lower stream of the Cloudy Han, where the northern limit ends.

sentences.zh: 箕與南斗相近，故其分野在吳、越之東。

translations.literal: Ji is close to the Southern Dipper; therefore its territorial field lies east of Wu and Yue.
translations.idiomatic: Ji is close to the Southern Dipper; therefore its territorial field lies east of Wu and Yue.

sentences.zh: 南斗、牽牛，星紀之次也。

translations.literal: The Southern Dipper and Ox Leader—the station of Xingji.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern Dipper and Ox Leader—the station of Xingji.

sentences.zh: 丑初起斗九度，一千四十二十分，秒二太。

translations.literal: At the beginning of chou it starts at Dou, nine degrees, one thousand four hundred twenty minutes, two seconds slightly excess.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of chou it starts at Dou, nine degrees, one thousand four hundred twenty minutes, two seconds slightly excess.

sentences.zh: 中斗二十四度，一千一百分，秒八半。

translations.literal: The midpoint is at Dou, twenty-four degrees, one thousand one hundred minutes, eight and a half seconds.
translations.idiomatic: The midpoint is at Dou, twenty-four degrees, one thousand one hundred minutes, eight and a half seconds.

sentences.zh: 終女四度。

translations.literal: It ends at Nü, four degrees.
translations.idiomatic: It ends at Nü, four degrees.

sentences.zh: 其分野：自廬江、九江，負淮水之南，盡臨淮、廣陵，至於東海，廬、壽、和、濠、揚，皆屬星紀也。

translations.literal: Its territorial field: from Lujiang and Jiujiang, south of the Huai River, to Linhuai and Guangling, reaching the Eastern Sea—Lu, Shou, He, Hao, and Yang all belong to Xingji.
translations.idiomatic: Its territorial field: from Lujiang and Jiujiang, south of the Huai River, to Linhuai and Guangling, reaching the Eastern Sea—Lu, Shou, He, Hao, and Yang all belong to Xingji.

sentences.zh: 又逾南河，得漢丹陽、會稽、豫章郡，西濱彭蠡，南涉越州，盡蒼梧、南海。

translations.literal: Also crossing the southern Yellow River, it includes Han's Danyang, Kuaiji, and Yuzhang commanderies, west bordering Poyang, south crossing Yue Prefecture, to the limits of Cangwu and Nanhai.
translations.idiomatic: Also crossing the southern Yellow River, it includes Han's Danyang, Kuaiji, and Yuzhang commanderies, west bordering Poyang, south crossing Yue Prefecture, to the limits of Cangwu and Nanhai.

sentences.zh: 又逾嶺表，自韶、廣、封、梧、藤、羅、雷州，南及珠崖自北以東為星紀，其西皆屬鶉尾之次。

translations.literal: Also crossing beyond the ranges, from Shao, Guang, Feng, Wu, Teng, Luo, and Lei prefectures, south to Zhuya—from the north eastward is Xingji; westward all belongs to the station of Zhenwei.
translations.idiomatic: Also crossing beyond the ranges, from Shao, Guang, Feng, Wu, Teng, Luo, and Lei prefectures, south to Zhuya—from the north eastward is Xingji; westward all belongs to the station of Zhenwei.

sentences.zh: 古吳、越及東南百越之國，皆星紀分也。

translations.literal: The ancient Wu, Yue, and the hundred Yue states of the southeast—all belong to the field of Xingji.
translations.idiomatic: The ancient Wu, Yue, and the hundred Yue states of the southeast—all belong to the field of Xingji.

sentences.zh: 南斗在雲漢之下流，當淮、海之間，為吳分。

translations.literal: The Southern Dipper lies below the stream of the Cloudy Han, between the Huai and the sea—the field of Wu.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern Dipper lies below the stream of the Cloudy Han, between the Huai and the sea—the field of Wu.

sentences.zh: 牽牛去南河浸遠，故其分野自豫章東達會稽，南逾嶺徼，為越分。

translations.literal: Ox Leader grows distant from the southern Yellow River; therefore its territorial field from Yuzhang east to Kuaiji, south beyond the frontier ranges, is the field of Yue.
translations.idiomatic: Ox Leader grows distant from the southern Yellow River; therefore its territorial field from Yuzhang east to Kuaiji, south beyond the frontier ranges, is the field of Yue.

sentences.zh: 島夷蠻貊之人，聲教之所不洎，皆系于狗國。

translations.literal: The island Yi and Man and Mo peoples, where civilizing influence does not reach—all are tied to the Dog Country.
translations.idiomatic: The island Yi and Man and Mo peoples, where civilizing influence does not reach—all are tied to the Dog Country.

sentences.zh: 李淳風刊定《隋志》，郡國頗為詳悉，所注郡邑多依用。

translations.literal: Li Chunfeng edited and fixed the Sui Treatise; its commanderies and kingdoms were quite detailed, and the commanderies and counties he annotated were largely adopted.
translations.idiomatic: Li Chunfeng edited and fixed the Sui Treatise; its commanderies and kingdoms were quite detailed, and the commanderies and counties he annotated were largely adopted.

sentences.zh: 其後州縣又隸管屬不同，但據山河以分耳。

translations.literal: Afterward prefectures and counties again had different supervisory affiliations; they were divided only according to mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward prefectures and counties again had different supervisory affiliations; they were divided only according to mountains and rivers.

sentences.zh: 肅宗十月辛巳朔。

translations.literal: Suzong, tenth month, xinsi, first day of the month.
translations.idiomatic: Suzong, tenth month, xinsi, first day of the month.

sentences.zh: 七月癸未朔，蝕既，大星皆見。

translations.literal: Seventh month, guiwei, first day of the month—total eclipse; all the great stars were visible.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, guiwei, first day of the month—total eclipse; all the great stars were visible.

sentences.zh: 代宗三月乙巳朔，四年正月十五日甲午蝕。

translations.literal: Daizong, third month, yisi, first day of the month; fourth year, first month, fifteenth day, jiawu—eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Daizong, third month, yisi, first day of the month; fourth year, first month, fifteenth day, jiawu—eclipse.

sentences.zh: 十三年甲戌，有司奏合蝕不蝕。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year, jiaxu—the responsible officials reported that an eclipse was due but did not occur.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteenth year, jiaxu—the responsible officials reported that an eclipse was due but did not occur.

sentences.zh: 十四年二月丙寅朔。

translations.literal: Fourteenth year, second month, bingyin, first day of the month.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteenth year, second month, bingyin, first day of the month.

sentences.zh: 德宗八月辛巳朔，日蝕。

translations.literal: Dezong, eighth month, xinsi, first day of the month—solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Dezong, eighth month, xinsi, first day of the month—solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 有司奏，准禮請伐鼓於社，不許。

translations.literal: The responsible officials reported that according to ritual they requested beating drums at the altar of Earth; this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible officials reported that according to ritual they requested beating drums at the altar of Earth; this was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 太常卿董晉諫曰：「伐鼓所以責群陰，助陽德，宜從經義。」

translations.literal: Director of Ceremonies Dong Jin remonstrated: "Beating drums is to hold the multitude of yin accountable and assist yang virtue; the canonical rites ought to be followed."
translations.idiomatic: Director of Ceremonies Dong Jin remonstrated: "Beating drums is to hold the multitude of yin accountable and assist yang virtue; the canonical rites ought to be followed."

sentences.zh: 竟不報。

translations.literal: In the end there was no reply.
translations.idiomatic: In the end there was no reply.

sentences.zh: 六年正月戊戌朔，有司奏合蝕不蝕，百僚稱賀。

translations.literal: Sixth year, first month, wuxu, first day of the month—the responsible officials reported that an eclipse was due but did not occur; the hundred officials offered congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth year, first month, wuxu, first day of the month—the responsible officials reported that an eclipse was due but did not occur; the hundred officials offered congratulations.

sentences.zh: 七年六月庚寅朔，有司奏蝕，是夜陰雲不見，百官表賀。

translations.literal: Seventh year, sixth month, gengyin, first day of the month—the responsible officials reported an eclipse; that night clouds obscured it and it was not seen; the hundred officials submitted congratulatory memorials.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh year, sixth month, gengyin, first day of the month—the responsible officials reported an eclipse; that night clouds obscured it and it was not seen; the hundred officials submitted congratulatory memorials.

sentences.zh: 八年十一月壬子朔，先是司天監徐承嗣奏：「據曆，合蝕八分，今退蝕三分。

translations.literal: Eighth year, eleventh month, renzi, first day of the month—earlier the Director of the Astronomy Bureau Xu Chengsi reported: "According to the calendar, an eclipse of eight-tenths was due; now the retreating eclipse is three-tenths.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth year, eleventh month, renzi, first day of the month—earlier the Director of the Astronomy Bureau Xu Chengsi reported: "According to the calendar, an eclipse of eight-tenths was due; now the retreating eclipse is three-tenths.

sentences.zh: 准占，君盛明則陰匿而潛退。

translations.literal: According to divination, when the ruler is bright and enlightened, yin hides and silently retreats.
translations.idiomatic: According to divination, when the ruler is bright and enlightened, yin hides and silently retreats.

sentences.zh: 請書于史。」

translations.literal: I request that this be recorded in the history."
translations.idiomatic: I request that this be recorded in the history."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 十年四月癸卯朔，有司奏太陽合虧，巳正後刻蝕之既，未正後五刻復滿。

translations.literal: Tenth year, fourth month, guimao, first day of the month—the responsible officials reported that the sun was due to be obscured; after the si hour it was totally eclipsed, and five quarters after the wei hour it was full again.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth year, fourth month, guimao, first day of the month—the responsible officials reported that the sun was due to be obscured; after the si hour it was totally eclipsed, and five quarters after the wei hour it was full again.

sentences.zh: 太常奏，准禮上不視朝。

translations.literal: The Director of Ceremonies reported that according to ritual the emperor did not hold court.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Ceremonies reported that according to ritual the emperor did not hold court.

sentences.zh: 其日陰雲不見，百官表賀。

translations.literal: That day clouds obscured it and it was not seen; the hundred officials submitted congratulatory memorials.
translations.idiomatic: That day clouds obscured it and it was not seen; the hundred officials submitted congratulatory memorials.

sentences.zh: 十七年五月壬戌蝕。

translations.literal: Seventeenth year, fifth month, renxu—eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Seventeenth year, fifth month, renxu—eclipse.

sentences.zh: 代宗即位。

translations.literal: Daizong ascended the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Daizong ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 其月壬子夜，西北方有赤光見，炎赫亙天，貫紫微，漸流於東，彌漫北方，照耀數十里，久之乃散。

translations.literal: That month on the night of renzi, red light appeared in the northwest, blazing across heaven, piercing the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, gradually flowing eastward, spreading across the north, illuminating for several tens of li; after a long time it dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: That month on the night of renzi, red light appeared in the northwest, blazing across heaven, piercing the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, gradually flowing eastward, spreading across the north, illuminating for several tens of li; after a long time it dispersed.

sentences.zh: 辛未夜，江陵見赤光貫北斗，俄僕固懷恩叛。

translations.literal: On the night of xinwei, Jiangling saw red light piercing the Northern Dipper; soon Pugu Huai'en rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of xinwei, Jiangling saw red light piercing the Northern Dipper; soon Pugu Huai'en rebelled.

sentences.zh: 明年十月，吐蕃陷長安，代宗避狄幸陝州。

translations.literal: The next year in the tenth month, Tibet captured Chang'an; Daizong fled the Di and went to Shaan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The next year in the tenth month, Tibet captured Chang'an; Daizong fled the Di and went to Shaan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 五月丁酉朔，日當蝕不蝕，群臣賀。

translations.literal: Fifth month, dingyou, first day of the month—the sun ought to have been eclipsed but was not; the ministers congratulated him.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, dingyou, first day of the month—the sun ought to have been eclipsed but was not; the ministers congratulated him.

sentences.zh: 十二月三日夜，星流如雨，自亥及曉。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, third day, night—stars fell like rain, from hai until dawn.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, third day, night—stars fell like rain, from hai until dawn.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯，太白經天，是月吐蕃逼京畿。

translations.literal: Ninth month, xinmao—Venus crossed heaven; that month Tibet pressed upon the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, xinmao—Venus crossed heaven; that month Tibet pressed upon the capital region.

sentences.zh: 二年六月丁未，日重輪，其夜月重輪，是年大水。

translations.literal: Second year, sixth month, dingwei—solar double halo; that night a lunar double halo; that year great floods.
translations.idiomatic: Second year, sixth month, dingwei—solar double halo; that night a lunar double halo; that year great floods.

sentences.zh: 十二月己亥，彗星出匏瓜，長尺餘，犯宦者星。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jihai—a comet emerged from Paogua, more than a foot long, invading the Eunuch star.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jihai—a comet emerged from Paogua, more than a foot long, invading the Eunuch star.

sentences.zh: 二年七月癸亥，熒惑色赤黃，順行入氐。

translations.literal: Second year, seventh month, guihai—Mars was red-yellow, moving direct into Di.
translations.idiomatic: Second year, seventh month, guihai—Mars was red-yellow, moving direct into Di.

sentences.zh: 乙丑夜，鎮星色黃，近辰星，在東井初度。

translations.literal: On the night of yichou, Saturn was yellow, close to Mercury, at the first degree of Dongjing.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of yichou, Saturn was yellow, close to Mercury, at the first degree of Dongjing.

sentences.zh: 丙寅申時，有青赤氣長四十餘尺，見日旁，久之乃散。

translations.literal: Bingyin, shen hour—blue-red qi more than forty feet long appeared beside the sun; after a long time it dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: Bingyin, shen hour—blue-red qi more than forty feet long appeared beside the sun; after a long time it dispersed.

sentences.zh: 己巳夜，歲星順行去司怪七寸。

translations.literal: On the night of jisi, Jupiter moved direct, seven inches from Siguai.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of jisi, Jupiter moved direct, seven inches from Siguai.

sentences.zh: 庚午夜，月逼天關。

translations.literal: On the night of gengwu, the moon approached Tianguan.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of gengwu, the moon approached Tianguan.

sentences.zh: 壬申十二月，赤氣長二丈亙日上。

translations.literal: Renshen, twelfth month—red qi two zhang long stretched across the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Renshen, twelfth month—red qi two zhang long stretched across the sun.

sentences.zh: 甲戌酉時，白氣亙天。

translations.literal: Jiaxu, you hour—white qi stretched across heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaxu, you hour—white qi stretched across heaven.

sentences.zh: 八月壬午，月入氐。

translations.literal: Eighth month, renwu—the moon entered Di.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, renwu—the moon entered Di.

sentences.zh: 戊子，月犯牽牛，相去九寸。

translations.literal: Wuzi—the moon invaded Ox Leader, nine inches apart.
translations.idiomatic: Wuzi—the moon invaded Ox Leader, nine inches apart.

sentences.zh: 己丑夜，月犯畢，相去四寸。

translations.literal: On the night of jichou, the moon invaded Bi, four inches apart.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of jichou, the moon invaded Bi, four inches apart.

sentences.zh: 九月戊申朔，歲星守東井，凡七日。

translations.literal: Ninth month, wushen, first day of the month—Jupiter guarded Dongjing for seven days.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, wushen, first day of the month—Jupiter guarded Dongjing for seven days.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，吐籓入寇，至邠寧。

translations.literal: Yimao—Tufan invaded, reaching Bianning.
translations.idiomatic: Yimao—Tufan invaded, reaching Bianning.

sentences.zh: 戊午夜，白霧起尾西北，彌漫亙天。

translations.literal: On the night of wuwu, white mist rose northwest of Wei, spreading across heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of wuwu, white mist rose northwest of Wei, spreading across heaven.

sentences.zh: 乙丑晝，有流星大如一升器，其色黃明，尾跡長六七十尺，出於午，流於丑。

translations.literal: Yichou, daytime—a meteor as large as a one-sheng vessel, yellow and bright, with a tail trace sixty or seventy feet long, emerging from wu and flowing to chou.
translations.idiomatic: Yichou, daytime—a meteor as large as a one-sheng vessel, yellow and bright, with a tail trace sixty or seventy feet long, emerging from wu and flowing to chou.

sentences.zh: 戊辰夜，熒惑去南斗五寸。

translations.literal: On the night of wuchen, Mars was five inches from the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of wuchen, Mars was five inches from the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，青赤氣亙於日旁。

translations.literal: Yihai—blue-red qi stretched beside the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Yihai—blue-red qi stretched beside the sun.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛酉夜，月去東井一尺。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, xinyou, night—the moon was one foot from Dongjing.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, xinyou, night—the moon was one foot from Dongjing.

sentences.zh: 甲子夜，月去軒轅一尺。

translations.literal: On the night of jiazi, the moon was one foot from Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of jiazi, the moon was one foot from Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，京師地震，有聲如雷，自東北來。

translations.literal: Renxu—Chang'an earthquake, with a sound like thunder, coming from the northeast.
translations.idiomatic: Renxu—Chang'an earthquake, with a sound like thunder, coming from the northeast.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁酉夜，熒惑入壁壘。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, dingyou, night—Mars entered Bilei.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, dingyou, night—Mars entered Bilei.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，有黑氣如霧，亙北方，久之方散。

translations.literal: Wuxu—black qi like mist stretched across the north; after a long time it dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: Wuxu—black qi like mist stretched across the north; after a long time it dispersed.

sentences.zh: 三年正月壬子夜，月掩畢。

translations.literal: Third year, first month, renzi, night—the moon covered Bi.
translations.idiomatic: Third year, first month, renzi, night—the moon covered Bi.

sentences.zh: 丁巳巳時，日有黃冠，青赤珥。

translations.literal: Dingsi, si hour—the sun had a yellow crown with blue-red ears.
translations.idiomatic: Dingsi, si hour—the sun had a yellow crown with blue-red ears.

sentences.zh: 三月乙巳朔，日有蝕之，自午虧，至後一刻，凡蝕十分之六分半。

translations.literal: Third month, yisi, first day of the month—the sun was eclipsed; from wu it waned, until one quarter past, eclipsing six and a half tenths in all.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, yisi, first day of the month—the sun was eclipsed; from wu it waned, until one quarter past, eclipsing six and a half tenths in all.

sentences.zh: 癸丑夜，太白去天衢八寸。

translations.literal: On the night of guichou, Venus was eight inches from Tiantian.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of guichou, Venus was eight inches from Tiantian.

sentences.zh: 癸酉夜，太白順行，去歲星二尺。

translations.literal: On the night of guiyou, Venus moved direct, two feet from Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of guiyou, Venus moved direct, two feet from Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 七月壬申夜，五星並列東井。

translations.literal: Seventh month, renshen, night—the five planets aligned in Dongjing.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, renshen, night—the five planets aligned in Dongjing.

sentences.zh: 占云：「中國之利。」

translations.literal: Divination says: "Benefit to China."
translations.idiomatic: Divination says: "Benefit to China."

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，月入畢。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jiyou—the moon entered Bi.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, jiyou—the moon entered Bi.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，月入東井。

translations.literal: Xinyou—the moon entered Dongjing.
translations.idiomatic: Xinyou—the moon entered Dongjing.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，火星去太白四寸。

translations.literal: Renxu—Mars was four inches from Venus.
translations.idiomatic: Renxu—Mars was four inches from Venus.

sentences.zh: 庚午夜，太白犯左執法，相去一尺。

translations.literal: On the night of gengwu, Venus invaded the Left Enforcer, one foot apart.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of gengwu, Venus invaded the Left Enforcer, one foot apart.

sentences.zh: 九月壬申夜，歲星入輿鬼。

translations.literal: Ninth month, renshen, night—Jupiter entered Yuji.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, renshen, night—Jupiter entered Yuji.

sentences.zh: 乙亥夜，大星如斗，自南流北，其光燭地。

translations.literal: On the night of yihai, a great star like a dipper flowed from south to north; its light illuminated the ground.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of yihai, a great star like a dipper flowed from south to north; its light illuminated the ground.

sentences.zh: 丁丑夜，熒惑入太微垣。

translations.literal: On the night of dingchou, Mars entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of dingchou, Mars entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 己卯夜，太白犯左執法，相去六寸。

translations.literal: On the night of jimao, Venus invaded the Left Enforcer, six inches apart.
