translations.idiomatic: After the fifth watch of renzi, the moon approached Venus, one foot apart.

sentences.zh: 四年正月二十二日，穆宗崩。

translations.literal: Fourth year, first month, twenty-second day—Muzong died.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year, first month, twenty-second day—Muzong died.

sentences.zh: 敬宗即位。

translations.literal: Jingzong ascended the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzong ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 二月癸卯，太白犯東井，近北轅。

translations.literal: Second month, guimao—Venus invaded Dongjing, near the northern axle.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, guimao—Venus invaded Dongjing, near the northern axle.

sentences.zh: 三月甲子，熒惑犯鎮星。

translations.literal: Third month, jiazi—Mars invaded Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiazi—Mars invaded Saturn.

sentences.zh: 壬申，太白犯東井，近北轅。

translations.literal: Renshen—Venus invaded Dongjing, near the northern axle.
translations.idiomatic: Renshen—Venus invaded Dongjing, near the northern axle.

sentences.zh: 四月十七日，染院作人張韶于柴草車中載兵器，犯銀臺門，共三十七人，入大內，對食於清思殿；

translations.literal: Fourth month, seventeenth day—the dye-house workers led by Zhang Shao, in a firewood cart carrying weapons, assaulted the Yintai Gate; thirty-seven men in all entered the inner palace and ate in the Hall of Pure Thought;
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, seventeenth day—the dye-house workers led by Zhang Shao, in a firewood cart carrying weapons, assaulted the Yintai Gate; thirty-seven men in all entered the inner palace and ate in the Hall of Pure Thought;

sentences.zh: 其日禁兵誅之。

translations.literal: that day the palace guard executed them.
translations.idiomatic: that day the palace guard executed them.

sentences.zh: 七月乙卯夜，有大星出於天船，流犯斗魁第一星西南滅。

translations.literal: Seventh month, yimao, night—a great star emerged from the Celestial Boat, flowing to invade and extinguish southwest of the first star of the Dipper's head.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, yimao, night—a great star emerged from the Celestial Boat, flowing to invade and extinguish southwest of the first star of the Dipper's head.

sentences.zh: 八月丁亥，熒惑犯鎮星。

translations.literal: Eighth month, dinghai—Mars invaded Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, dinghai—Mars invaded Saturn.

sentences.zh: 癸未，熒惑入東井。

translations.literal: Guiwei—Mars entered Dongjing.
translations.idiomatic: Guiwei—Mars entered Dongjing.

sentences.zh: 己丑，太白犯軒轅右角。

translations.literal: Jichou—Venus invaded the right horn of Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Jichou—Venus invaded the right horn of Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊子夜，月掩東井。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, wuzi, night—the moon covered Dongjing.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, wuzi, night—the moon covered Dongjing.

sentences.zh: 甲午夜，西北有流星出閣道，至北極滅。

translations.literal: On the night of jiawu, a northwest meteor emerged from Gedao, reaching the North Pole and extinguishing.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of jiawu, a northwest meteor emerged from Gedao, reaching the North Pole and extinguishing.

sentences.zh: 七月乙酉，月犯西咸，去八寸所。

translations.literal: Seventh month, yiyou—the moon invaded Xixian, seven inches apart.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, yiyou—the moon invaded Xixian, seven inches apart.

sentences.zh: 甲子夜，月掩畢。

translations.literal: On the night of jiazi, the moon covered Bi.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of jiazi, the moon covered Bi.

sentences.zh: 閏七月癸巳夜，月去心，距九寸。

translations.literal: Intercalary seventh month, guisi, night—the moon left Xin, nine inches apart.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary seventh month, guisi, night—the moon left Xin, nine inches apart.

sentences.zh: 庚子，流星去北極，至南斗柄滅。

translations.literal: Gengzi—a meteor left the North Pole, reaching the handle of the Southern Dipper and extinguishing.
translations.idiomatic: Gengzi—a meteor left the North Pole, reaching the handle of the Southern Dipper and extinguishing.

sentences.zh: 八月乙卯，太白犯房，相去九寸。

translations.literal: Eighth month, yimao—Venus invaded Fang, nine inches apart.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, yimao—Venus invaded Fang, nine inches apart.

sentences.zh: 九月癸未，太白犯南斗。

translations.literal: Ninth month, guiwei—Venus invaded the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, guiwei—Venus invaded the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，月犯畢。

translations.literal: Bingxu—the moon invaded Bi.
translations.idiomatic: Bingxu—the moon invaded Bi.

sentences.zh: 甲午，月犯太微左執法。

translations.literal: Jiawu—the moon invaded the Left Enforcer of the Supreme Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Jiawu—the moon invaded the Left Enforcer of the Supreme Palace.

sentences.zh: 十月辛卯，月犯天囷，相去七寸。

translations.literal: Tenth month, xinmao—the moon invaded Tiankun, seven inches apart.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, xinmao—the moon invaded Tiankun, seven inches apart.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，太白臨哭星，相去九寸。

translations.literal: Guihai—Venus approached the Weeping star, nine inches apart.
translations.idiomatic: Guihai—Venus approached the Weeping star, nine inches apart.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚辰，鎮星犯東井，相去七寸。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, gengchen—Saturn invaded Dongjing, seven inches apart.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, gengchen—Saturn invaded Dongjing, seven inches apart.

sentences.zh: 癸未夜，月去東井六寸。

translations.literal: On the night of guiwei, the moon was six inches from Dongjing.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of guiwei, the moon was six inches from Dongjing.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，西南大流星出羽林，入濁。

translations.literal: Wuxu—a great southwest meteor emerged from the Feathered Forest, entering Zhuo.
translations.idiomatic: Wuxu—a great southwest meteor emerged from the Feathered Forest, entering Zhuo.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申夜，月犯畢。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, wushen, night—the moon invaded Bi.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, wushen, night—the moon invaded Bi.

sentences.zh: 乙酉夜，西北方有霧起，須臾遍天。

translations.literal: On the night of yiyou, mist rose in the northwest; in an instant it filled heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of yiyou, mist rose in the northwest; in an instant it filled heaven.

sentences.zh: 霧上有赤氣，其色或深或淺，久而方散。

translations.literal: Above the mist was red qi, deep or pale in color; after a long time it dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: Above the mist was red qi, deep or pale in color; after a long time it dispersed.

sentences.zh: 二年正月甲戌夜，北方大流星長五丈餘，出紫微，過軫滅。

translations.literal: Second year, first month, jiaxu, night—a great northern meteor more than five zhang long emerged from the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, passing Zhen and extinguishing.
translations.idiomatic: Second year, first month, jiaxu, night—a great northern meteor more than five zhang long emerged from the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, passing Zhen and extinguishing.

sentences.zh: 甲申，月犯右執法，相去五寸。

translations.literal: Jiashen—the moon invaded the Right Enforcer, five inches apart.
translations.idiomatic: Jiashen—the moon invaded the Right Enforcer, five inches apart.

sentences.zh: 二月丙午夜，月犯畢。

translations.literal: Second month, bingwu, night—the moon invaded Bi.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, bingwu, night—the moon invaded Bi.

sentences.zh: 三月己巳，流星出河鼓，東過天市，入濁滅。

translations.literal: Third month, jisi—a meteor emerged from the River Drum, passing east through the Celestial Market, entering Zhuo and extinguishing.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jisi—a meteor emerged from the River Drum, passing east through the Celestial Market, entering Zhuo and extinguishing.

sentences.zh: 四月甲子夜，西方大流星長三丈，穿天市垣，至房星滅。

translations.literal: Fourth month, jiazi, night—a great western meteor three zhang long pierced the Celestial Market Enclosure, reaching Fang and extinguishing.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, jiazi, night—a great western meteor three zhang long pierced the Celestial Market Enclosure, reaching Fang and extinguishing.

sentences.zh: 其月十七日，白虹貫日連環，至午方滅。

translations.literal: That month on the seventeenth day, a white rainbow pierced the sun in linked rings, extinguishing at wu.
translations.idiomatic: That month on the seventeenth day, a white rainbow pierced the sun in linked rings, extinguishing at wu.

sentences.zh: 五月甲戌，月去太微八寸所。

translations.literal: Fifth month, jiaxu—the moon was eight inches from the Supreme Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, jiaxu—the moon was eight inches from the Supreme Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，西北方大流星長三丈，光明照地，入天市垣中滅。

translations.literal: Guisi—a great northwest meteor three zhang long, light illuminating the ground, entering within the Celestial Market Enclosure and extinguishing.
translations.idiomatic: Guisi—a great northwest meteor three zhang long, light illuminating the ground, entering within the Celestial Market Enclosure and extinguishing.

sentences.zh: 甲午五更。

translations.literal: Jiawu, fifth watch.
translations.idiomatic: Jiawu, fifth watch.

sentences.zh: 熒惑犯昴。

translations.literal: Mars invaded Mao.
translations.idiomatic: Mars invaded Mao.

sentences.zh: 六月庚申，太白犯昴。

translations.literal: Sixth month, gengshen—Venus invaded Mao.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, gengshen—Venus invaded Mao.

sentences.zh: 七月壬申，流星長二丈，出斗北，入濁滅。

translations.literal: Seventh month, renshen—a meteor two zhang long emerged north of Dou, entering Zhuo and extinguishing.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, renshen—a meteor two zhang long emerged north of Dou, entering Zhuo and extinguishing.

sentences.zh: 其夜，月初入，巳上有流星向南滅。

translations.literal: That night, at the beginning of the month, above si a meteor flowed south and extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: That night, at the beginning of the month, above si a meteor flowed south and extinguished.

sentences.zh: 其夜，辰犯畢。

translations.literal: That night, Chen invaded Bi.
translations.idiomatic: That night, Chen invaded Bi.

sentences.zh: 八月丙申夜，北方大流星長四丈餘，出王良，流至北斗柄滅。

translations.literal: Eighth month, bingshen, night—a great northern meteor more than four zhang long emerged from Wangliang, flowing to the handle of the Northern Dipper and extinguishing.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, bingshen, night—a great northern meteor more than four zhang long emerged from Wangliang, flowing to the handle of the Northern Dipper and extinguishing.

sentences.zh: 甲辰夜，太白去太微八寸所。

translations.literal: On the night of jiachen, Venus was eight inches from the Supreme Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of jiachen, Venus was eight inches from the Supreme Palace.

sentences.zh: 丁未夜，熒惑近鎮星西北。

translations.literal: On the night of dingwei, Mars approached Saturn northwest.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of dingwei, Mars approached Saturn northwest.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，熒惑去輿鬼七寸。

translations.literal: Dingchou—Mars was seven inches from Yuji.
translations.idiomatic: Dingchou—Mars was seven inches from Yuji.

sentences.zh: 十二月八日夜，敬宗為內官劉克明所弑，立絳王。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, eighth day, night—Jingzong was murdered by the inner official Liu Keming; the Prince of Jiang was installed.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, eighth day, night—Jingzong was murdered by the inner official Liu Keming; the Prince of Jiang was installed.

sentences.zh: 樞密使王守澄等殺絳王，立文宗。

translations.literal: Palace Secretariat Commissioner Wang Shoucheng and others killed the Prince of Jiang and installed Wenzong.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Secretariat Commissioner Wang Shoucheng and others killed the Prince of Jiang and installed Wenzong.

sentences.zh: 武宗即位。

translations.literal: Wuzong ascended the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Wuzong ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 六月二十九日，從一鼓至五鼓，小流星五十餘，交橫流散。

translations.literal: Sixth month, twenty-ninth day—from the first drum to the fifth drum, more than fifty small meteors crossed and scattered.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, twenty-ninth day—from the first drum to the fifth drum, more than fifty small meteors crossed and scattered.

sentences.zh: 七月二日，北方流星光明照地，東北流星有聲如雷。

translations.literal: Seventh month, second day—a northern meteor's light illuminated the ground; a northeastern meteor sounded like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, second day—a northern meteor's light illuminated the ground; a northeastern meteor sounded like thunder.

sentences.zh: 九月癸巳，熒惑犯輿鬼。

translations.literal: Ninth month, guisi—Mars invaded Yuji.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, guisi—Mars invaded Yuji.

sentences.zh: 閏九月丁酉，熒惑貫鬼宿；

translations.literal: Intercalary ninth month, dingyou—Mars pierced the Ghost lodge;
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary ninth month, dingyou—Mars pierced the Ghost lodge;

sentences.zh: 戊戌，在鬼中。

translations.literal: Wuxu—it was within Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: Wuxu—it was within Ghost.

sentences.zh: 十一月六日，彗見西南，在室初度，凡五十六日而滅。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, sixth day—a comet appeared in the southwest, at the first degree of Shi; after fifty-six days it was extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, sixth day—a comet appeared in the southwest, at the first degree of Shi; after fifty-six days it was extinguished.

sentences.zh: 其夜上方大流星光明燭地，東北流星有聲。

translations.literal: That night above, a great meteor's light illuminated the ground; a northeastern meteor had sound.
translations.idiomatic: That night above, a great meteor's light illuminated the ground; a northeastern meteor had sound.

sentences.zh: 二年六月乙丑，熒惑犯歲星。

translations.literal: Second year, sixth month, yichou—Mars invaded Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: Second year, sixth month, yichou—Mars invaded Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，太白犯東井。

translations.literal: Bingyin—Venus invaded Dongjing.
translations.idiomatic: Bingyin—Venus invaded Dongjing.

sentences.zh: 其夜，熒惑蒼赤色，動搖于井中，至八月十六日，犯輿鬼。

translations.literal: That night, Mars was blue-red in color, stirring within Jing; until the sixteenth day of the eighth month it invaded Yuji.
translations.idiomatic: That night, Mars was blue-red in color, stirring within Jing; until the sixteenth day of the eighth month it invaded Yuji.

sentences.zh: 五年二月五日，太白掩昴北側，在昴宿一度。

translations.literal: Fifth year, second month, fifth day—Venus covered the north side of Mao, at the first degree of the Mao lodge.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth year, second month, fifth day—Venus covered the north side of Mao, at the first degree of the Mao lodge.

sentences.zh: 五月辛酉，太白入畢口，距星東南一尺。

translations.literal: Fifth month, xinyou—Venus entered the mouth of Bi, one foot southeast of the distance star.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, xinyou—Venus entered the mouth of Bi, one foot southeast of the distance star.

sentences.zh: 八月七日，太白犯軒轅大星。

translations.literal: Eighth month, seventh day—Venus invaded the great star of Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, seventh day—Venus invaded the great star of Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 舊儀：太史局隸秘書省，掌視天文曆象。

translations.literal: Former regulations: the Astronomy Bureau was subordinate to the Secretariat, supervising observation of heaven, the calendar, and celestial signs.
translations.idiomatic: Former regulations: the Astronomy Bureau was subordinate to the Secretariat, supervising observation of heaven, the calendar, and celestial signs.

sentences.zh: 則天朝，術士尚獻輔精於曆算，召拜太史令。

translations.literal: In the reign of Empress Wu, the technician Shang Xianfu was skilled in calendar calculation and was summoned and appointed Director of the Astronomy Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In the reign of Empress Wu, the technician Shang Xianfu was skilled in calendar calculation and was summoned and appointed Director of the Astronomy Bureau.

sentences.zh: 獻輔辭曰：「臣山野之人，性靈散率，不能屈事官長。」

translations.literal: Xianfu declined: "I am a man of the mountains and wilds, by nature free and ungoverned; I cannot bow to serving official superiors."
translations.idiomatic: Xianfu declined: "I am a man of the mountains and wilds, by nature free and ungoverned; I cannot bow to serving official superiors."

sentences.zh: 天后惜其才，五月十九日，敕太史局不隸秘書省，自為職局，仍改為渾天監。

translations.literal: The Empress regretted losing his talent; on the nineteenth day of the fifth month she decreed that the Astronomy Bureau would no longer be subordinate to the Secretariat, becoming an independent office, and was renamed the Bureau of the Armillary Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress regretted losing his talent; on the nineteenth day of the fifth month she decreed that the Astronomy Bureau would no longer be subordinate to the Secretariat, becoming an independent office, and was renamed the Bureau of the Armillary Heaven.

sentences.zh: 至七月六日，又改為渾儀監。

translations.literal: By the sixth day of the seventh month it was again renamed the Bureau of the Armillary Sphere.
translations.idiomatic: By the sixth day of the seventh month it was again renamed the Bureau of the Armillary Sphere.

sentences.zh: 八月，獻輔卒，復為太史局，隸秘書省，緣進所置官員並廢。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Xianfu died; it reverted to the Astronomy Bureau, subordinate to the Secretariat, and the officials he had advanced were all abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Xianfu died; it reverted to the Astronomy Bureau, subordinate to the Secretariat, and the officials he had advanced were all abolished.

sentences.zh: 六月，改為太史監，不隸秘書省。

translations.literal: Sixth month—it was changed to the Astronomy Directorate, not subordinate to the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month—it was changed to the Astronomy Directorate, not subordinate to the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 七月，復為太史局，隸秘書省。

translations.literal: Seventh month—it reverted to the Astronomy Bureau, subordinate to the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month—it reverted to the Astronomy Bureau, subordinate to the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 八月，又改為太史監。

translations.literal: Eighth month—it was again changed to the Astronomy Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month—it was again changed to the Astronomy Directorate.

sentences.zh: 十一月，又改為太史局。

translations.literal: Eleventh month—it was again changed to the Astronomy Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month—it was again changed to the Astronomy Bureau.

sentences.zh: 二年閏九月，改為渾儀監。

translations.literal: Second year, intercalary ninth month—it was changed to the Bureau of the Armillary Sphere.
translations.idiomatic: Second year, intercalary ninth month—it was changed to the Bureau of the Armillary Sphere.

sentences.zh: 二月，改為太史監。

translations.literal: Second month—it was changed to the Astronomy Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: Second month—it was changed to the Astronomy Directorate.

sentences.zh: 十五年正月，改為太史局，隸秘書省，

translations.literal: Fifteenth year, first month, it was changed to the Astronomy Bureau, subordinate to the Secretariat,
translations.idiomatic: Fifteenth year, first month, it was changed to the Astronomy Bureau, subordinate to the Secretariat,

sentences.zh: 又改為太史監。

translations.literal: and again changed to the Astronomy Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: and again changed to the Astronomy Directorate.
